article_title: Analysis of quantum-related courses and textbooks for potential integration of quantum sensing
citation: Namitha Pradeep and Ben Zwickl. (2026). Analysis of quantum-related courses and textbooks for potential integration of quantum sensing. https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23507
title: Interactive dataset of 8456 quantum-related courses from 1456 US institutions
description: A course database collected by a team of eight members who systematically searched program and course catalogs of 1456 institutions nationwide for courses including the word quantum in title or description, recording title, course number, description, prerequisites, departments, and level. As printed, "A total of 8456 courses were recorded and are available in an interactive online dataset." The dataset underpins both the landscape statistics cited in the article and the 121-course sensing subset analyzed here.
requirements: Systematic catalog searching across institutions nationwide
examples: The same study identified over 4700 physics-department courses mentioning quantum, approximately 1600 QM courses, and 600 modern physics courses
